flowOptions.merged: Wood merged — Press into Print, Sew-out into Sew-in
flowOptions.noSew: No-sew — QC jumps straight to Pack

flowHint.standard: Orders go through all 6 stages: Print → Press → QC → Sew-in → Sew-out → Pack.
flowHint.merged: Print done auto-completes Press; Sew-in done auto-completes Sew-out. Wood factories only.
flowHint.noSew: QC done auto-completes Sew-in + Sew-out; order waits at Pack (still confirmed manually). For factories without sewing.
flowHint.pressComplete: Print → Press; once Press completes, QC + Sew-in + Sew-out + Pack all auto-complete — the order finishes production immediately and customer notifications/webhooks fire as with manual packing. Enable for DTF factories.

autoPack.label: Auto-complete Packing
autoPack.hint: On: orders reaching the Packing stage complete automatically (production finished, notifications/webhooks fire as with manual packing). Only applies to NEW arrivals — use the button below for the current backlog.
autoPack.sweepConfirm: Complete ALL orders currently waiting at the Packing stage of factory {{name}}?
autoPack.sweepPartial: Completed {{ok}} orders, {{fail}} failed (held orders / invalid state).

skipToolCheck.label: Skip tool check
skipToolCheck.hint: On: NEW orders imported/pushed into this factory are stamped tool-checked "ok" at creation and go straight to the Print stage — no Support review, no designer auto-assign. New orders only; in-flight orders are untouched.

autoStockOut.label: Auto stock-out after label print
autoStockOut.hint: On: at the scan station, after printing an order's shipping label the system automatically deducts inventory (blanks) for that order — no ACT-STOCK-OUT confirmation scan needed. Repeat deductions are harmless: each order is deducted once unless a rework deduction is made deliberately.

importDialog.title: Import Product Config
importDialog.description: Paste data from Excel (tab-separated). 7 columns in order: Full name — Short name (may be left blank) — Machine (machine number, e.g. 94/27, leave blank = no tool) — Factory (e.g. "ME LINH") — Fabric type (POLY 2 DA, ME 64, LUA 4B, LUA VAN GO…) — Tool result (leave blank = has tool; "no tool" = no tool) — Department (machine type, e.g. "PRINT AND LASER CUT"). The system matches labels by name (case-insensitive).
importDialog.parseError: No rows could be parsed. Check the format (7 columns, separated by Tab).

uploadConfigDialog.title: Upload config file
uploadConfigDialog.description: Pick an Excel file (.xlsx) with the product list (columns Tên SP / short name / Nhà máy / Phòng — same layout as the SKU THÁI NGUYÊN-MÊ LINH file). Names are compared against existing configs and only products NOT yet configured are shown for selection. Rows without a short name are still accepted — one is generated from the product name ("auto" badge).
uploadConfigDialog.parseError: Could not read any data from the file — make sure it has a "Tên SP" header row plus Nhà máy and Phòng columns.
uploadConfigDialog.parsed: {{total}} valid rows in file — {{existing}} already configured, {{fresh}} new.
uploadConfigDialog.noNew: Every product in the file already exists in the config.

importFullDialog.title: Import full products from file
importFullDialog.description: Choose an Excel file (.xlsx) using the full-product template: one row per product (with catalog columns: Category, Collection, Mockup URL, Description, Specifics...), variations on following rows (SKU, Color, Size, prices). Existing products are UPDATED — only fields present in the file overwrite, variations merge by SKU.
importFullDialog.parseError: No products found — check the file has a "Tên SP" column plus SKU/Category/Mockup columns
importFullDialog.skippedRows: {{count}} rows skipped (no product name or SKU).
